body_markdown:
DALLAS, TX (September 9. 2026)— MarineMax Dallas is partnering with Cars & Coffee to host “Yachts, Cars & Coffee: Honor Our Heroes,” a free community event honoring the Combat Veterans Motorcycle Association® (CVMA®) TX 23-1. The event takes place Saturday, September 12, 2026, from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. at MarineMax Dallas, 1490 N. Stemmons Freeway, Lewisville, TX 75067.


MarineMax Dallas and Cars & Coffee are co-hosting the event, but the CVMA members are the guests of honor. The nonprofit organization is made up of combat veterans who support those who have served. Members will be present throughout the event, and attendees can donate through the event’s registration link or the on-site QR code.


The event will feature the boat models from Sea Ray, Harris Pontoon, Boston Whaler, and Cruisers Yachts alongside a lineup of high-end, exotic, and classic cars. Food vendors on-site include Nana’s Cheesecake and Lone Star Wagyu Beef Hotdogs, and Snow Exciting On the Go, along with local vendors selling boating gear and luxury car accessories.


The event is free and open to the public. RSVPs are encouraged. Car owners can register a vehicle for display at app.parkupfront.com/event/11819. Vendors interested in participating can contact


emily.newell@marinemax.com .
